headline: NBA: Lakers survive late Kings rally to escape Sacramento with thrilling 106-104 victory
teaser: A crucial defensive stop in the final seconds and clutch free throws seal a dramatic 106-104 road triumph for the Lakers, while Nikola Jokic records a 32-point triple-double for Denver.
story:
The Los Angeles Lakers held their nerve in a classic California rivalry thriller on Friday night, 20 November, fending off a ferocious fourth-quarter rally by the Sacramento Kings for a 106-104 victory at Golden 1 Center.

Leading by seven with under two minutes remaining, the Lakers withstood back-to-back three-pointers from De'Aaron Fox, who paced Sacramento with 29 points. With the game tied at 104 and 14 seconds on the clock, Los Angeles executed a clean pick-and-roll to draw a foul, converting two pressure-packed free throws. Sacramento had one final chance to win or force overtime, but a suffocating perimeter trap forced an off-balance jumper at the horn that clanged off the rim.

The hard-fought victory improves the Lakers to 10-4. Elsewhere in NBA Friday action, Nikola Jokic notched a 32-point, 12-rebound, 10-assist triple-double in Denver's 133-124 shootout victory over Houston, while Cleveland held off Indiana 128-119.
whyCareReason: The Lakers survive a heart-stopping finish in Sacramento to earn their tenth win of the season.
stakes: Los Angeles (10-4) keeps pace with the top of the Western Conference, while Sacramento (7-7) drops to .500.
rivalryAngle: Heated Pacific Division rivalry that has now seen four of the last five meetings decided by three points or fewer.
funFacts: The Lakers held Sacramento to just 18 points in the decisive third quarter.
Nikola Jokic recorded his fifth triple-double of the season on Friday in Denver's win over Houston.
The Kings missed their final four three-point attempts over the closing 75 seconds.
